verdict.rationale: Apify publishes a documented public REST API (v2 docs, plus an OpenAPI spec that returns HTTP 200) and official JS and Python API clients. Those docs cover authentication, running Actors, retrieving results, pagination, retries, error handling and webhooks, so an AI-native user can drive the platform programmatically. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on community corroboration of using the API.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API
